name: My Magical Girl Romance
source:
Originally released for Lemmasoft's second annual "Worst VN/KN" challenge in 2013, My Magical Girl Romance follows a guy named Mo whom is randomly approached by a weird redhead named Risa who wishes to tell you a secret. Whether or not you believe this secret will determine YOUR fate!

[From [url=https://tofu-sheets-visual.itch.io/my-magical-girl-romance]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《我的魔法少女罗曼史》最初是为2013年Lemmasoft的第二届年度“最差VN/KN”挑战而发布的，讲述了一个名叫Mo的男人被一个名叫Risa的奇怪红发女郎随机接近的故事，她想告诉你一个秘密。你是否相信这个秘密将决定你的命运！

[来自[url=https://tofu-sheets-visual.itch.io/my-magical-girl-romance]Itch.io[/url]]
